answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 156328 Country: India Title: Showing negligence towards the Holy Quran in childhood Question: I am from India. At my small age without finishing the full Quran I will turn some pages and finished, because of my friends silly competition (Astaghfirullah). Now I felt very much of guilty & fear. Please give the solution of my mistake. After that issue I never read Quran & felt guilty. Is there any solution of the issue? Please guide me to myself get normal, in-shaAllah. Answer ID: 156328 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 289/225/B=2/1439) Whatsoever faults you committed in your childhood it was bad and you remained ignorant of the Holy Quran. Now the solution is that you must take out one hour in the morning and one hour in the evening and learn to read the Holy Quran before any good Qari. You should read it attentively and work hard then in-shaAllah, you shall become able to read the Holy Quran correctly within one or two years. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
